title: Map Ref (.mrf) — locations, regions, weather/terrain/footstep tables

container.notes: World file type 9 id 4. Little-endian. Header: u32 at +0 (section count by analogy), then 10 u32 file-relative section offsets (section i at 4+4*i; sections 0 and 1 confirmed). Section 0 = 8-byte location records, section 1 = 16-byte region records; sections 3/4/5 = weathers/terrains/footsteps (layouts unknown). Loaded at [0x02099D88] with offsets kept relative.

records.name: header
records.where: File offset 0; in memory the loaded file starts at [0x02099D88] and offsets stay file-relative (the code adds the file base).

fields.name: sectionCount
fields.notes: Not read by any source. By analogy with the battlepack header (count at +0, offsets from +4) it is expected to be the section count (10); verify on a real file. [src: TK L241 (analogy), L438]

fields.name: section0Offset
fields.notes: Offset of section 0 (Locations) from the file start. Confirmed by the weather lookup code. [src: Drive getWeather.lua:2-24]

fields.name: section1Offset
fields.notes: Offset of section 1 (Regions) from the file start. Confirmed by the weather lookup code. [src: Drive getWeather.lua:2-24]

fields.name: section2Offset
fields.notes: Offset of section 2 (unnamed) from the file start. Position inferred from sections 0/1 and the 10-section count. [src: TK L1178 (pattern inferred)]

fields.name: section3Offset
fields.notes: Offset of section 3 (Weathers) from the file start. Position inferred from sections 0/1 and the 10-section count. [src: TK L1178 (pattern inferred)]

records.name: location
records.where: section0Offset + locationId*8 (locationId = the current location id at World +0x1044 / [0x021654C4])

fields.name: unknown00
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: regionId
fields.notes: Region (section 1 row) the location belongs to; selects the weather table. [src: Drive getWeather.lua:2-24]

fields.name: unknown04
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: unknown00
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: weatherSlot0
fields.notes: Weather id used when the weather mode (World +0x1060 / [0x021654E0]) is 0. [src: Drive getWeather.lua:2-24]

fields.name: unknown05
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: weatherSlot1
fields.notes: Weather id for weather mode 1 (slot = +0x04 + mode*4). [src: Drive getWeather.lua:2-24]

fields.name: unknown09
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

fields.name: weatherSlot2
fields.notes: Weather id for weather mode 2 (if that mode exists). [src: Drive getWeather.lua:2-24]

fields.name: unknown0D
fields.notes: Not identified by any source; keep the original bytes.

roundTrip: Edit location.regionId and region weather slots in place; nothing moves.
Keep the header word at +0x00 and every unknown byte unchanged.
When resizing a section, rewrite all later section offsets and preserve the original alignment/padding pattern (unknown rule).
After writing the file, hot-reload it (File Reloader -> Map Ref, type 9 id 4) or change area.
gaps: File name and VBF path of the .mrf file.
Header word +0x00 (section count by analogy) and the position of section offsets 2-9 (inferred).
Location bytes 0x00-0x01 and 0x04-0x07; region bytes other than the weather slots; how many weather modes exist.
Layouts of sections 2-9 (Weathers, Terrains, Footsteps and the unnamed ones).
Section alignment and end-of-file padding rules; section entry counts (derived from offset differences, inferred).
